existing.name: Speaker eligibility
existing.english: The speaker's status is approved, the topic is on their approved list, and their contract is active on the dinner date. Otherwise block.

existing.name: HCP identity
existing.english: Every invitee resolves to an NPI and a recipient type. A weak match becomes a pick-list, never a guess. Otherwise flag.

existing.name: Per-person meal cap
existing.english: The estimated per-person cost, including tax and tip, is at or under the company cap. Block before the dinner; after the dinner, an actual per-person cost over the cap goes to compliance.

existing.name: Annual cap per HCP
existing.english: Each HCP's year-to-date spend plus this dinner stays under their annual cap. Block that HCP if over; flag when above 80% of the cap.

existing.name: OIG red flags
existing.english: Flag alcohol on the receipt, an HCP attending the same topic for the third time in 12 months, and non-HCP guests such as spouses.

existing.name: Open Payments draft
existing.english: Per-person value is the printed total, including tax and tip, divided by everyone who ate. Draft a food-and-beverage row only for covered recipients who attended, including the speaker. No-shows get no row. Drafted, humans file.

output.name: Weekend dinners
output.citationLabel: Company compliance policy: weekend speaker dinners require manager approval (fictional company policy)

rules.message: Dinners on a Saturday or Sunday need manager approval before they go ahead.

tests.name: Friday late dinner is not a weekend (edge case)
